reader.requirement: At --std 85 one CLOSE statement must accept and close file-names of mixed organization (sequential, relative, indexed) and access mode (sequential, random, dynamic), each with the phrases its own module allows, with the effect of separate CLOSE statements in written order.

edition-consulted.switches: CLOSE WITH LOCK removal gate at 2023 (close-with-lock-removed-2023); inactive at 85
DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: from 2002 the connector is locked, at 85 the physical file

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: mixing organizations in one CLOSE is the same at every edition; only what WITH LOCK locks and whether WITH LOCK is admitted differ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf18_02 covers two sequential files and one relative random file; indexed files, dynamic access and per-file phrases in a mixed list are not exercised

reader.notes: BindClose resolves each file-name on its own and splits the statement into one implicit CLOSE per file; the only organization test is the NO REWIND/REEL/UNIT screen, which the other modules' formats require. COBOL1693 cites §2023:14.9.6.3 SR1 at --std 85 rather than the 1985 module text (cosmetic).
